title: Settings
description: Save to apply changes. Download and processing defaults affect new tasks only.
invalid: Check input limits and the filename template.

general.saveLocationHint: Used for new tasks after saving settings.
general.chooseDirectory: Choose the save location through the folder picker.

resumeOnStart.label: Resume tasks on startup
resumeOnStart.hint: Continue the tasks that were downloading or queued when the app last quit.

notifications.label: Notify when downloads finish
notifications.hint: Show a system notification when a file is saved.

minimizeToTray.label: Keep downloading after closing the window
minimizeToTray.hint: Minimize to the system tray; quit from the tray menu.

keepHistory.label: Keep parse history
keepHistory.hint: Keep successfully parsed links on this computer for reuse.

workMode.label: Work mode
workMode.downloadHint: Save original media without subtitles or transcoding.
workMode.editHint: Use platform subtitles, local transcription and video exports while preserving originals.

concurrency.label: Simultaneous downloads
concurrency.hint: Up to 4 tasks download in parallel.

taskSpeedLimit.label: Default per-task speed limit (KiB/s)
taskSpeedLimit.hint: 0 means unlimited; can be adjusted per task in task details.

timeout.label: Connection timeout (seconds)
timeout.hint: Retry when a connection or media read stalls for too long.

retries.label: Download retries
retries.hint: Retry after a file or fragment fails; once exhausted you can retry manually.

batchLimit.label: Batch limit
batchLimit.hint: Queue the first N selected items per click; 0 means no limit.

files.namingHint: The task ID prevents files with the same name overwriting each other. Retries reuse the original file name and resume where supported.

organizeByPlatform.label: Subfolder per platform
organizeByPlatform.hint: New tasks are saved to the matching platform folder.

organizeByCollection.label: Subfolder per collection
organizeByCollection.hint: Keep each collection or multipart video in its own folder.

files.mergeHint: Separate video and audio streams are merged automatically. Photo posts keep the original image format.

save.label: Save the cover image with videos
save.hint: Store a cover image with the same name next to the video.

embedVideo.label: Embed the cover in video files
embedVideo.hint: Make the cover the video file's own artwork; some players and File Explorer don't read MP4 cover tracks.

embedAudio.label: Embed the cover in audio-only downloads
embedAudio.hint: Audio files carry the cover, shown by players as album art.

cover.hint: Most platforms serve WebP, which Windows File Explorer thumbnails inconsistently. Photo posts get no extra cover, since the post itself is images. "Download cover" in a task's context menu is always available, regardless of these switches.

subtitles.label: Subtitles
subtitles.languagesPlaceholder: Leave empty to follow the interface language
subtitles.languagesHint: Comma-separated, in order of priority; enter all to download every language.

autoGenerated.label: Use auto-generated subtitles
autoGenerated.hint: Fall back to the platform's speech-recognition subtitles when a language has no human-made ones.

normalize.label: Normalize overlapping subtitle cues
normalize.hint: Join YouTube rolling caption fragments so one language does not render twice at once.

subtitles.hint: Uses captions provided by the platform, including platform-generated captions when enabled. No client-side translation. Embedded or burned captions affect only the output, leaving the source intact.

cleanNaming.templateHint: Click a field to insert it. title is the title, author is the author name, and date is the publication date; authorId is the author account and id identifies the item.
cleanNaming.invalidTemplate: Enter a template using the listed fields, without path separators or ..
cleanNaming.sampleTitle: How to photograph a city at night
cleanNaming.nicknameFallback: The platform did not provide an author ID; the author name will be used.
cleanNaming.noAuthor: The author name is unavailable; it will be omitted.
cleanNaming.noDate: The publication date is unavailable; the date will be omitted.
cleanNaming.hint: New tasks have no random suffix. Duplicate names receive (2), (3), etc. Queued tasks keep their names. The extension depends on the media.

browser.noSessions: No saved sessions. Sign in through the app when needed.
browser.sessionsHint: For content that requires signing in, sign in once in the app; the sign-in session is stored on this computer and survives restarts.

tools.kernelAutomaticHint: Check official stable releases weekly. Verify before use in new tasks; keep the current kernel on failure.
tools.localHint: Local tools update with the app; downloading and parsing run on this computer.

verboseLogging.label: Verbose logging
verboseLogging.hint: Record request details for troubleshooting. Credentials are redacted and logs stay on this computer.

allowControl.label: Command line & agents
allowControl.hint: Set up the galaxy command for terminals and agents. Only the current user on this computer can connect.

commandLine.ready: Enabled. Run galaxy in a new terminal.
commandLine.disabled: Command line and agent control is disabled.
commandLine.needsSetup: The command is not ready. Retry setup.
commandLine.failed: Command line setup failed. Retry or check diagnostics logs.
commandLine.channelFailed: The command line connection is unavailable. Close other clients and retry.
commandLine.enableFirst: Enable and save command line and agent control first.

editing.languageHint: For example zh, en; up to 5 languages.
editing.modelHint: Models download on demand. Audio is processed on this computer.
editing.hint: Export to a new file and preserve the original. Video processing uses these format and resolution defaults.
editing.resolutionHint: Resolution only decreases, capped by the shorter edge. Aspect ratio is preserved without stretching or cropping.
